concept: Custom geometric uppercase letter M with integrated cat-ear upper peaks and signature single-ear cream white tip

usage_guidelines.social_profile_picture: Use meowndr-logo-primary.png directly as square or circular PFP on YouTube, TikTok, X, Instagram.
usage_guidelines.overlays_and_merchandise: Use meowndr-logo-transparent.png or meowndr-logo.svg for transparent overlays, stamps, video watermarks, or apparel.
usage_guidelines.single_ear_accent_rule: The cream-white tip must remain on the left ear only. The right ear must remain solid orange.
usage_guidelines.integrity_rule: Do not add eyes, noses, whiskers, mouths, or character features into the lettermark.
